summary: The root دخر (dkhr) describes being object, mean, contemptible, or despicable. It implies a state of lowliness or abasement.
lane: 1 دَخَرَ دخر , (S, A, Msb, K,) aor. دَخَرَ ; (Msb, K;) and دَخِرَ , aor. دَخَرَ ; (K;) inf. n. of the former, دُخُورٌ , (S, A, Msb, K,) and (of the latter, TA) دَخَرٌ ; (K, TA; in the CK دُخْرٌ ;) He was, or became, object, mean, contemptible, or despicable. (S, A, Msb, K.)
